description: This file defines the ClientDTO class, a Data Transfer Object used within the application's messaging infrastructure to represent client data, including an ID, name, and associated projects

classes.name: ClientDTO
classes.description: A serializable Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing client information, including ID, name, and associated projects, with overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods

methods.name: getProjectDTOS
methods.description: Returns the set of associated ProjectDTO objects

methods.name: setProjectDTOS
methods.description: Sets the set of associated ProjectDTO objects

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equality method to compare ClientDTO objects based on clientId, clientName, and projectDTOS

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides the default hashCode method to produce a hash based on clientId, clientName, and projectDTOS

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the ClientDTO object
